summary: Dogfood the current Project Review System against the local-first refactor roadmap and preserve the End-to-end-discovered governance gap without retroactive stage credit.
reason: End-to-end validation discovered that the initial roadmap review used the five semantic stages without the current Project Review System's governed Adaptive Execution/change-impact/pass-boundary machinery. Prior semantic reports are preserved as uncredited analysis. Review revision 1 reopens at Adversarial against the current roadmap snapshot, with a durable gate created before new pass credit. The dogfooding-gap note is an implementation-planning requirement, not retroactive evidence. Revision-1 Adversarial then re-attacked the full corrected roadmap under the current gate and found no blocking defect; nonblocking collaboration-provenance, dirty-snapshot, and executable-adapter assurance obligations are handed to Interdependency and later implementation validation.

reasons: The corrected roadmap is bounded to five durable review artifacts plus the dogfooding-gap note; prior broad Adversarial analysis is available as historical input, and this reopened pass can re-attack the full current design in one dedicated execution unit.

workload.notes: Reopened after End-to-end validation found ungated dogfooding false credit. This gate applies only to the new Adversarial execution unit; earlier analysis remains uncredited.

capability.benchmark_evidence: Built-in separated default; not a claim of measured reviewer capability.

decision.assurance_boundary: Semantic judgment determines whether one pass is suitable and which bounded subpasses require isolation. Deterministic policy defaults to SEPARATED, converts declared isolation requirements into ISOLATED subpasses, and permits FUSED only through exact pre-existing VALIDATED capability permission. The gate and completion validator enforce the recorded plan but do not prove the semantic assessment itself was correct.

findings: The dogfooding false-credit defect is now explicitly contained: earlier ungated stage reports remain historical analysis only, and governed credit restarts at revision 1 with a pre-existing Adversarial gate.

The selected local-first architecture still preserves the major Adversarial invariants: semantic/mechanical separation, exact snapshot binding, least-privilege provider configuration, no required hosted CI, replay/concurrency controls, migration integrity, manual fallback, and breadth enforcement.

Portable review-bundle import must preserve reviewer/authority provenance as well as lineage; Interdependency should assign the producer/consumer contract so imported evidence cannot silently gain stronger authority than its source.

The Git snapshot adapter must make dirty-working-tree/snapshot-capture behavior explicit, and executable external adapters must not be described as proven network-isolated merely because they are configured as local; these are implementation assurance obligations already bounded by the exact-snapshot and provider-trust requirements.
unresolved_conditions: Interdependency must map ownership and authority for governed-dogfood mode/preflight, imported portable-bundle provenance, and any assurance label applied to executable external adapters.
Later implementation and End-to-end validation must test dirty Git working-tree snapshot behavior rather than assuming commit identity and reviewed bytes are always the same.
